name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Growth & GTM Lead with 8+ years of experience launching zero-to-one ventures, designing Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, and scaling multi-channel acquisition funnels. Entrepreneurial operator skilled in rapid experimentation, customer journey positioning, and funnel analytics (CAC, LTV, conversion, retention). Proven track record co-founding an AI startup (Meu Barzin), driving native AI adoption (#1 global growth rate at Meta/Wipro), and using Vibe Coding workflows to set up growth infrastructure and automate GTM execution.

bullets: 0-to-1 AI Venture Launch & GTM Strategy: Owned product positioning and go-to-market execution for an AI-first venture, onboarding 200+ partners into a Supabase (PostgreSQL) vector database connected via N8N webhooks, Python, and Vibe Coding.

Bootstrapped Acquisition & Funnel CRO: Acquired 500+ qualified leads with a minimal budget (R$ 10-20/day) by running qualitative conversation log audits, A/B prompt testing, and fixing latency bottlenecks to boost active funnel engagement to 22.3%.

Native AI GTM Adoption (#1 Global Growth Rate): Led the GTM rollout of Meta's native AI CRM features across 150+ analysts by targeting New Hires in 1-on-1 setup sessions, driving the operation from last place to 4th/5th in overall volume and #1 globally in % adoption growth.

Next Level Bootcamp Pilot (-50% Ramp-Up): Designed and executed a soft-skills onboarding pilot (12 consultants, 100% completion) to accelerate routine integration and performance, reducing time-to-productivity from 6 to 3 months (-50%).

Interpersonal Leadership & Culture Award: Received Wipro's company-wide 'Be Respectful' Values Award (1 of 5 core company values awarded, selected among 300 employees) for exceptional cross-functional collaboration.

Inbound Acquisition & A/B Testing (+250%): Designed interactive web funnels and landing pages that boosted monthly inbound lead capture from 8 to 20-30 contacts (+250%) through rapid positioning and messaging tests.

0-to-1 Product Launch & Revenue: Built custom e-commerce product infrastructure generating R$ 10,000 in organic revenue in 3 months with 100% LGPD/GDPR data privacy compliance across 40+ client portals.

Automated Multi-Channel Nurture (~R$ 50k): Built automated email nurture pipelines (Bitrix24/Sendpulse) attracting 10,000+ visits and generating ~R$ 50,000 in high-ticket revenue (~10 enrollments at R$ 5,000).
0-to-1 LMS Product Launch: Designed and automated a digital LMS tripwire course (WordPress), securing 50 sales in 2 months with a 1.0x-1.5x ROI.
